# Godwit

An open-source, AI-native email client you can extend.

Godwit is a desktop email client for macOS, Windows and Linux. It works with any IMAP/SMTP account and ships with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose. Everything AI in it, the built-in features included, runs through the same extension points open to you: drop in a `SKILL.md` and a button appears.

The name comes from the bar-tailed godwit, which holds the record for the longest non-stop bird flight.

> Status: 0.0.x, early preview. Expect rough edges, and keep a copy of anything important on your mail server.

## Features [...] Mail: IMAP/SMTP accounts with sync, offline changes, conversations, full-text search, and HTML compose with reply, forward, CC/BCC and drafts. Setup is detected for Gmail, Outlook (sign in with Microsoft), iCloud, Yahoo, AOL, QQ Mail, 163/126 Mail, Tencent Exmail, Lark/Feishu and DingTalk Mail, and any other IMAP server.
 Wit: an agent that answers questions about your mail, reads attachments (PDF, Office, CSV) and drafts replies. It never sends without your approval.
 AI actions: summarize, translate, adjust tone and length, and quick replies, on a message, a selection or a draft. On macOS 26 and later, mail can also be translated on the Mac with the system's own translation, free and without a model (Settings › Intelligence › Features › Translate with › System translation). results.content:
### Extensions

Drop in a SKILL.md and a button appears. TypeScript plugins with declared permissions add cards, actions and Wit tools; MCP servers give Wit external tools. The built-in AI features use the same extension points.

### For other agents

godwit mcp is an MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor and other agents read your mail and create drafts, but never send.

## Your mail goes only where you let it

No Godwit account, no telemetry, no server relaying your mail. Below is every connection Godwit makes.

### Your mail stays on this computer

Synced mail, drafts and the search index live in the data directory on this computer.

### Passwords live only in the system keychain

Never written to config files, never shown in logs.

Network connections [...] ### Mail

IMAP/SMTP sync, offline changes, conversations, full-text search and HTML compose. Setup is detected for Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, QQ Mail, 163/126, Lark/Feishu, DingTalk and more.

### Wit

Answers questions about your mail, reads attachments (PDF, Office, CSV) and drafts replies. It never sends without your approval.

### AI actions

Summarize, translate, adjust tone and length, and quick replies, on a message, a selection or a draft.

### Your models

Any OpenAI-compatible (Chat Completions or Responses) or Anthropic-compatible service, including local ones like Ollama and LM Studio. API keys stay in the system keychain.
